name: Inter-section rule
purpose: Mark a change of subject with the lightest possible division — the only inter-section chrome this page has.

placement.rule: Present at exactly 4 of the 8 section boundaries. This is NOT a uniform rhythm and must not be regularised into one.
placement.correction: ia.json's description says 'four of the nine section boundaries'. Nine SECTIONS produce eight boundaries; the same file's `scope` field states 4 of 8 correctly. Cite 4 of 8.
